significance: The most famous Shani shrine among the nine Navagraha temples of the Kaveri delta, where Saturn's image stands within a Paadal Petra Sthalam of Shiva. The present masonry is 9th-century Chola work with Vijayanagar-era expansions.
story: When a corrupt headman threatened a shepherd who supplied milk for the lord's ablutions, Shiva is said to have intervened with his trident to stop the king's punishment.
